aggrescan_a3v.name: AGGRESCAN amino-acid aggregation propensity (a3v)
aggrescan_a3v.reference: Conchillo-Solé O. et al. (2007). AGGRESCAN: a server for the prediction and evaluation of 'hot spots' of aggregation in polypeptides. BMC Bioinformatics, 8, 65.
aggrescan_a3v.source_note: Additional file 1 of the paper (12859_2006_1437_MOESM1_ESM.pdf), parsed 2026-10-12. Hot-spot threshold -0.02 and hot-spot rules from Additional file 2.

top_idp.name: TOP-IDP disorder propensity scale
top_idp.reference: Campen A. et al. (2008). TOP-IDP-scale: a new amino acid scale measuring propensity for intrinsic disorder. Protein Pept Lett, 15(9), 956-963.

disorder_residue_classes.name: Order- and disorder-promoting residues
disorder_residue_classes.reference: Dunker A.K. et al. (2001). Intrinsically disordered protein. J Mol Graph Model, 19(1), 26-59.
disorder_residue_classes.source_note: Residue lists as restated in Campen et al. 2008 (PMC2676888, Introduction), which cites Dunker 2001; 2026-10-12.

plaac.name: PLAAC prion-like domain model (S. cerevisiae, 28 prion domains)
plaac.reference: Lancaster A.K. et al. (2014). PLAAC: a web and command-line application to identify proteins with prion-like amino acid composition. Bioinformatics, 30(17), 2501-2502.
plaac.source_note: Ported 2026-10-12 from the PLAAC source (github.com/whitehead/plaac, cli/src/plaac.java: prd_freq_scer_28, bg_freq_scer, prionhmm1).
